user.title: Tuya Body Fat Scale Setup
user.description: Enter your Tuya IoT Platform credentials

data.device_id: Device ID (optional with a User Code)

data_description.user_code: Smart Life / Tuya Smart app > Me > Settings (gear) > Account and Security > User Code. Leave empty to keep polling only; with a code you scan a QR next and get instant updates when someone steps on the scale.
data_description.region: Data center of your Tuya IoT project.
data_description.device_id: Leave empty when you enter a User Code: you will pick the scale from the list of devices in your account.

qr.title: Scan the QR code
qr.description: Open the Smart Life / Tuya Smart app, tap the scan icon on the Me tab (top right), scan the code and confirm. Then press Submit.

data_description.height: Only used when the scale does not report a height for this user.

device.title: Choose your scale
device.description: These are the devices of the account you just linked. Body fat scales are listed first.

select_users.title: Choose users
select_users.description: Pick the people who use this scale. An entry named unknown (or with ID 0) is a weighing the scale could not assign to a profile; it is not selected by default.

reauth_confirm.title: Link your Tuya account again
reauth_confirm.description: The QR login expired or was revoked, so instant updates are paused. Confirm your User Code and scan a new QR code.

reauth_api.title: Update the Tuya API credentials
reauth_api.description: Tuya rejected the Access ID / Access Key. Enter valid ones from the Tuya IoT Platform.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Tuya API
error.no_users: No users found on the scale
error.invalid_age: Invalid age range (must be between 0-120 years)
error.qr_failed: Could not create a login QR code. Check the user code.
error.qr_not_scanned: The QR code was not confirmed yet. Scan it in the app and press Submit again.
error.device_not_in_account: This device was not found in the app account you scanned with.
error.device_id_required: Enter a Device ID, or a User Code to pick the scale from your account.

abort.no_devices: No devices were found in that account.

relink.title: Link your Tuya account
relink.description: Smart Life / Tuya Smart app > Me > Settings (gear) > Account and Security > User Code. Instant updates need this link.

relink_qr.title: Scan the QR code
relink_qr.description: Open the Smart Life / Tuya Smart app, tap the scan icon on the Me tab (top right), scan the code and confirm. Then press Submit.

data_description.height: Only used when the scale does not report a height for this user.
data_description.remove: Deletes the user's entities. Their history on the scale is not touched.

add_users.title: Add users
add_users.description: These users were found on the scale but are not set up yet.

data_description.height: Only used when the scale does not report a height for this user.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not read the users from the Tuya API.
abort.no_new_users: All users found on the scale are already set up.

error.invalid_age: Invalid age range (must be between 0-120 years)
error.qr_failed: Could not create a login QR code. Check the user code.
error.qr_not_scanned: The QR code was not confirmed yet. Scan it in the app and press Submit again.
error.device_not_in_account: This device was not found in the app account you scanned with.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Tuya API
error.cannot_remove_last: The last user cannot be removed.

session_expired.title: Tuya QR login expired
session_expired.description: Tuya rejected the QR login several times in a row, so instant (MQTT) updates for scale {device_id} are off and the integration only polls. Open Settings > Devices & services, choose this integration and re-authenticate by scanning a new QR code (or use Configure > Link / re-link QR).

device_not_in_account.title: Scale not found in the linked account
device_not_in_account.description: The scale {device_id} is not in the Smart Life / Tuya Smart account used for the QR login, so instant updates are off. Check that the User Code belongs to the account that owns the scale, then use Configure > Link / re-link QR.

api_quota_exhausted.title: Tuya API quota exhausted
api_quota_exhausted.description: Tuya answered: {error}. New weighings cannot be analysed until the IoT Core service is renewed in the Tuya IoT Platform (Cloud > Cloud Services). The last known values stay visible until then.
